      • getParentNode

        public Node getParentNode()
        从接口复制的说明: Node
        The parent of this node. All nodes, except Attr, Document, DocumentFragment, Entity, and Notation may have a parent. However, if a node has just been created and not yet added to the tree, or if it has been removed from the tree, this is null.

      • getData

        public String getData()
               throws DOMException
        The character data of the node that implements this interface. The DOM implementation may not put arbitrary limits on the amount of data that may be stored in a CharacterData node. However, implementation limits may mean that the entirety of a node's data may not fit into a single DOMString. In such cases, the user may call substringData to retrieve the data in appropriately sized pieces.
        指定者:
        getData 在接口中 CharacterData
        覆盖:
        getData 在类中 DefaultText
        抛出:
        DOMException - NO_MODIFICATION_ALLOWED_ERR: Raised when the node is readonly.
        DOMException - DOMSTRING_SIZE_ERR: Raised when it would return more characters than fit in a DOMString variable on the implementation platform.

      • getLength

        public int getLength()
        The number of 16-bit units that are available through data and the substringData method below. This may have the value zero, i.e., CharacterData nodes may be empty.
        指定者:
        getLength 在接口中 CharacterData
        覆盖:

      • substringData

        public String substringData(int offset,
                            int count)
                     throws DOMException
        Extracts a range of data from the node.
        指定者:
        substringData 在接口中 CharacterData
        覆盖:
        substringData 在类中 DefaultText
        参数:
        offset - Start offset of substring to extract.
        count - The number of 16-bit units to extract.
        返回:
        The specified substring. If the sum of offset and count exceeds the length, then all 16-bit units to the end of the data are returned.
        抛出:
        DOMException - INDEX_SIZE_ERR: Raised if the specified offset is negative or greater than the number of 16-bit units in data, or if the specified count is negative.
        DOMSTRING_SIZE_ERR: Raised if the specified range of text does not fit into a DOMString.
